title: Proton pump inhibitor use and the risk of small intestinal bacterial overgrowth: a meta-analysis
population: 11 studies comparing small intestinal bacterial overgrowth in adult PPI users and non-users, searched to July 2012
funder: Not read: the publisher page refused access and the article is not in PubMed Central.
result: Pooled OR of small intestinal bacterial overgrowth in PPI users 2.282 (95% CI 1.238 to 4.205); in studies diagnosing overgrowth by duodenal or jejunal aspirate culture OR 7.587 (1.805 to 31.894); in studies using the glucose hydrogen breath test OR 1.93 (0.69 to 5.42). Funnel-plot analysis identified 4 outlying studies, indicating possible publication bias.
